slides.say: Need a group, but not an extra div in the page? Use a Fragment.
The empty tags group the title and the body into one element that you can return.

slides.text: In the DOM, it is as if they were never grouped: no extra node.
slides.say: In the browser, the Fragment leaves nothing behind. It is exactly as if the elements were not grouped at all.
The empty tag is shorthand for the Fragment component, which you can import from react.
